resources.string: The first launch extracts game data to internal storage. Keep the app open.
Graphics and server changes apply the next time you enter the game.
Enter a server IPv4 address or hostname, without a protocol or port.
Local pairing requires a loopback or LAN IPv4 address, such as 192.168.1.20. Turn it off for a cloud server.
The port must be between 1 and 65535.

Menus: tap with one finger to select or confirm.
Character selection: tap a character, then the enter button at the bottom right.

Normal inventory: tap to inspect; hold still for half a second to use a usable item or learn a skill. To move an item, press and drag immediately; releasing outside the inventory restores it.
The four bottom potion slots: tap to use; holding does not repeat.

In the game world:
Drag one finger in the movement area to move.
Tap the skill area to select; double-tap to cast the current skill.
Swipe two fingers left or right to change skills.
Swipe two fingers up or down, or pinch, to adjust the camera.
Swipe three fingers up for the map or down for settings.

The bottom potion bar and interface controls do not trigger world skills.
The APK is missing game-data.zip; this is not a complete game package.
Not enough internal storage. At least %1$s more is required.
Maximum display refresh rate: %1$d Hz. Choose a frame rate from 30 to %1$d.
